items.title: US strikes on alleged drug boats may constitute ‘crimes against humanity’, UN expert says

sentences.en: US strikes on alleged drug boats may constitute ‘crimes against humanity’, UN expert says.
sentences.zh: 联合国专家表示，美国对涉嫌贩毒船只的袭击可能构成“危害人类罪”。

sentences.en: Dozens of US attacks on boats in the Pacific and Caribbean have killed more than 230 people since September 2025 A special rapporteur for the UN human rights council has concluded that there are “reasonable grounds to believe” that the United States attacks on boats allegedly carrying drugs in the Pacific and Caribbean “constituted crimes against humanity”.

sentences.en: The boat strikes, carried out since September 2025 on the stated grounds of stopping drugs being trafficked by sea to the US, have killed more than 230 people.
sentences.zh: 自2025年9月以来，以阻止海上向美国贩运毒品为由进行的船只罢工已造成230多人死亡。

sentences.en: The latest, on Saturday, killed four people in the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 最近的一起发生在周六，在加勒比地区造成4人死亡。

sentences.zh: 基民盟在两次地区选举中遭受了重大损失，包括在前领导人安格拉·默克尔（ Angela Merkel ）的家乡，在那里只有4.9 ％的民意调查留在德国，大众，宝马，梅赛德斯-奔驰和其他汽车品牌的数万名汽车工人今天在全国各地的工厂车间抗议政府和管理层帮助挽救他们的工作。

sentences.en: Volkswagen has announced plans to cut 100,000 jobs in the next three years and BMW and Mercedes are also slashing their workforce.
sentences.zh: 大众汽车宣布计划在未来三年内裁员10万人，宝马和奔驰也在裁员。

sentences.en: The problem is a near-existential one: the rise of Chinese EV carmakers with their cheaper, and in some cases more advanced models, has thrown the German car industry into crisis.
sentences.zh: 问题几乎是存在的：中国电动汽车制造商的崛起及其更便宜，在某些情况下更先进的车型，使德国汽车行业陷入危机。

sentences.en: The Germans, who have been far slower to transition to electric vehicles, simply aren’t selling as many cars anymore and need to retool to keep up.
The fears are reflective of wider concerns over Europe’s industrial base being eroded by Chinese competition.
sentences.zh: 这些担忧反映了对欧洲工业基础受到中国竞争侵蚀的更广泛担忧。

items.title: Python Workers are now generally available

sentences.en: Python Workers are now generally available.
We introduced Python Workers two years ago, providing a way to run Python applications in the Cloudflare Workers runtime.
Our goal was to make it as simple to write Workers in Python as it is in TypeScript, and to make the ecosystem of Python packages and frameworks “just work”.
Today, Python Workers are now generally available (GA).
What does GA mean?
sentences.zh: GA是什么意思？

sentences.en: It means Python is now a first-class, fully supported language on the Cloudflare Developer Platform.

You can bring the Python code, libraries, and design patterns you already know and connect them seamlessly to Workers AI, R2, D1, Hyperdrive, Durable Objects, Queues, Workflows, and the rest of the Cloudflare platform.
You can also run popular Python frameworks like FastAPI, Django, and Flask inside Python Workers.
sentences.zh: 您还可以在Python Workers中运行流行的Python框架，如FastAPI、Django和Flask。

sentences.en: You can even create a Python Worker inside another Worker using Dynamic Workers .
sentences.zh: 您甚至可以使用动态Worker在另一个Worker中创建Python Worker。

sentences.en: The journey behind Python Workers Bringing Python to Cloudflare Workers was a natural choice.
sentences.zh: Python Workers背后的旅程将Python引入Cloudflare Workers是一个自然的选择。

sentences.en: Because Workers has supported WebAssembly since 2018 , it gave us the perfect environment to run a Wasm-compiled Python interpreter.
sentences.zh: 由于Workers自2018年以来一直支持WebAssembly ，因此它为我们提供了运行Wasm编译的Python解释器的完美环境。

sentences.en: By using Pyodide , we were able to quickly support a wide range of Python applications in Cloudflare Workers.
sentences.zh: 通过使用Pyodide ，我们能够在Cloudflare Workers中快速支持广泛的Python应用程序。

items.title: Knowledge cutoff is a poor proxy for model capability

sentences.en: Knowledge cutoff is a poor proxy for model capability.
A model’s knowledge cutoff marks the latest date its training data could cover.
sentences.zh: 模型的知识截止日期标志着其训练数据可能涵盖的最新日期。

sentences.en: But its actual knowledge of a product might end years earlier or be absent entirely.
I learned this while trying to answer what seemed like a straightforward question: how much does a model know about a product?
If the model’s knowledge ended around a particular date, I should have been able to translate that date to a product version.
The model knows the product up to roughly version X.
sentences.zh: 该模型知道产品的大致版本为X。

sentences.en: Anything introduced after that needs additional context.
On paper, that would be useful when building agent extensions.
You could establish what the model already knows and supply the missing documentation, saving the context window for the work.
In practice, the results showed no consistent boundary.
Looking for the line To test it, I used GPT-5.6 Luna with the GitHub Copilot SDK against two developer products: Dev Proxy and SharePoint Framework (SPFx).
I fed the changelogs and release notes for both products to GPT-5.6 Sol and asked it to extract product changes, excluding things like dependency updates and CI infrastructure work.
